GRADE 9 ARABIC — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ARABIC
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Reading Fluency at school, which statement is correct?
   A. read a text on formal greetings and introduction,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading Fluency completely.
   C. Reading Fluency is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading Fluency.

2. About Reading Fluency at home, which statement is correct?
   A. apply appropriate speed and intonation in written texts for fluency,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading Fluency completely.
   C. Reading Fluency is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading Fluency.

3. About Reading Fluency in your community, which statement is correct?
   A. read a text on formal greetings and introduction,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading Fluency completely.
   C. Reading Fluency is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading Fluency.

5. About Reading Fluency at school, which statement is correct?
   A. read a text on formal greetings and introduction,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading Fluency completely.
   C. Reading Fluency is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading Fluency.

6. About Reading Fluency at home, which statement is correct?
   A. apply appropriate speed and intonation in written texts for fluency,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading Fluency completely.
   C. Reading Fluency is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading Fluency.

7. About Reading Fluency in your community, which statement is correct?
   A. read a text on formal greetings and introduction,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading Fluency completely.
   C. Reading Fluency is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading Fluency.

9. About Reading for Comprehension at school, which statement is correct?
   A. read a short text fluently and at a good pace,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading for Comprehension completely.
   C. Reading for Comprehension is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading for Comprehension.

10. About Reading for Comprehension at home, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to questions from a text based on the theme,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading for Comprehension completely.
   C. Reading for Comprehension is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading for Comprehension.

11. About Reading for Comprehension in your community, which statement is correct?
   A. read a short text fluently and at a good pace,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading for Comprehension completely.
   C. Reading for Comprehension is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading for Comprehension.

13. About Reading Fluency: Pronunciation at school, which statement is correct?
   A. read simple words with the correct pronunciation of particles (harf) for fluency,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading Fluency: Pronunciation completely.
   C. Reading Fluency: Pronunciation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading Fluency: Pronunciation.

14. About Reading Fluency: Pronunciation at home, which statement is correct?
   A. apply appropriate speed when reading a text for fluency,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading Fluency: Pronunciation completely.
   C. Reading Fluency: Pronunciation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading Fluency: Pronunciation.

15. About Reading Fluency: Pronunciation in your community, which statement is correct?
   A. read simple words with the correct pronunciation of particles (harf) for fluency,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading Fluency: Pronunciation completely.
   C. Reading Fluency: Pronunciation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading Fluency: Pronunciation.

17. About Reading for Information at school, which statement is correct?
   A. identify vocabulary from a text for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading for Information completely.
   C. Reading for Information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading for Information.

18. About Reading for Information at home, which statement is correct?
   A. infer the meaning of vocabulary for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading for Information completely.
   C. Reading for Information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading for Information.

19. About Reading for Information in your community, which statement is correct?
   A. identify vocabulary from a text for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading for Information completely.
   C. Reading for Information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading for Information.

21. About Reading for Information at school, which statement is correct?

   B. Learners should ignore Reading for Information completely.
   C. Reading for Information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading for Information.

   B. Learners should ignore Reading for Information completely.
   C. Reading for Information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading for Information.

23. About Reading for Information in your community, which statement is correct?
   A. identify vocabulary from a text for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading for Information completely.
   C. Reading for Information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading for Information.

25. About Reading Aloud: Dialogue at school, which statement is correct?
   A. identify characters in a dialogue for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading Aloud: Dialogue completely.
   C. Reading Aloud: Dialogue is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading Aloud: Dialogue.

26. About Reading Aloud: Dialogue at home, which statement is correct?
   A. apply appropriate speed and accuracy in reading a dialogue,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading Aloud: Dialogue completely.
   C. Reading Aloud: Dialogue is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading Aloud: Dialogue.

27. About Reading Aloud: Dialogue in your community, which statement is correct?
   A. identify characters in a dialogue for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading Aloud: Dialogue completely.
   C. Reading Aloud: Dialogue is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading Aloud: Dialogue.

29. About Reading for Information: Visuals at school, which statement is correct?
   A. identify vocabulary from a text for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading for Information: Visuals completely.
   C. Reading for Information: Visuals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading for Information: Visuals.

30. About Reading for Information: Visuals at home, which statement is correct?
   A. infer the meaning of vocabulary for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading for Information: Visuals completely.
   C. Reading for Information: Visuals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading for Information: Visuals.

31. About Reading for Information: Visuals in your community, which statement is correct?
   A. identify vocabulary from a text for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading for Information: Visuals completely.
   C. Reading for Information: Visuals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading for Information: Visuals.
